Overview

Lyon is a city in Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes with a population of 522,000. France’s gastronomic capital with a rich Roman history, Renaissance architecture, and a thriving culinary scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
